question: Did a 2015 study really lead 70% of students to remember committing a crime?
answer: Not by a stricter test. Shaw and Porter counted 70% after three suggestive interviews. Recoding the same transcripts, Wade, Garry and Pezdek separated believing the story from recalling it, and only 26 to 30% met the bar for a false memory. The larger figure included people who believed but pictured little.
move: Before quoting a rate, ask exactly what was counted as a case.
